name: Cyril Morlet

Observability and incident response are personal: Prometheus and Sentry telemetry over self-hosted production, root cause analysis where downtime costs my own revenue. Ex-Bitfinex exchange backend. Python at tooling level, honestly stated; TypeScript/Node.js is where I am deepest.
